title: The Birth of Lord Rama
story: King Dasharatha of Ayodhya longs for a son and performs a sacred yajna. A divine offering is given to his queens, and in time Rama, Bharata, Lakshmana and Shatrughna are born.

title: The Arrival of Sage Vishwamitra
story: Sage Vishwamitra arrives at King Dasharatha's court and asks that Rama accompany him to protect his sacred yajna.

title: Rama Protects the Yajna
story: Rama and Lakshmana travel with Vishwamitra and protect his sacred yajna from forces that seek to disturb it.

title: Sita's Swayamvara
story: In Mithila, King Janaka announces a great challenge for Sita's swayamvara. Princes from many kingdoms gather to attempt it.

title: Rama Breaks Shiva's Bow
story: Rama approaches the mighty bow of Shiva. With divine strength, he lifts the bow and breaks it, astonishing everyone present.

title: Rama and Sita's Wedding
story: After Rama succeeds at the swayamvara, preparations begin for the wedding of Rama and Sita, bringing joy to Mithila and Ayodhya.

title: Kaikeyi's Two Boons
story: Queen Kaikeyi remembers two promises granted by Dasharatha. She asks that Bharata become king and Rama be sent into exile for fourteen years.

title: Rama Accepts Exile
story: Rama learns that he must leave Ayodhya for fourteen years. Instead of anger, he accepts the decision to protect his father's honor.

title: Sita Chooses to Follow Rama
story: Sita refuses to remain in Ayodhya while Rama lives in the forest. She chooses to accompany her husband despite the hardships ahead.

title: Lakshmana Joins Rama
story: Lakshmana decides that he cannot let Rama and Sita face the forest alone. He leaves Ayodhya with them and begins their journey.
